questions.question: The ratio of the current ages of a mother and her daughter is 6 : 2. After 5 years if the ratio of their ages becomes 7 : 3, then what is the current age of the daughter?
questions.questionHtml: The ratio of the current ages of a mother and her daughter is 6 : 2. After 5 years if the ratio of their ages becomes 7 : 3, then what is the current age of the daughter?
questions.solution:
Let the ages of the mother and the daughter be '6x' years and '2x' years respectively,

After 5 years,

\(\frac{6x+5}{2x+5}=\frac{7}{3}\)

(6x + 5) 3 = (2x + 5)7

x = 5

Current age of the daughter = 2x 

= 2 × 5 = 10 years

Hence, the current age of the daughter is 10 years.

4) 8 balls are left in the park → False (as there are 6 + 10 – 7 balls left i.e., 9 balls)

Hence, the statement given in option 3 is true.

questions.question: The sum of ages of a daughter and mother is 63 yr. Four years back, the mother's age was 4 times that of daughter's age at that time. What is the present age of the mother?
questions.questionHtml: The sum of ages of a daughter and mother is 63 yr. Four years back, the mother's age was 4 times that of daughter's age at that time. What is the present age of the mother?
questions.solution:
The sum of ages of a daughter and mother is 63 yr.

Let the age of daughter be A and the age of the mother be  B.

A + B = 63

Four years back.

A - 4 and B - 4

This means A + B = 55 (after deduction 4 years from both mother and daughter.)

Four years back mother's age was 4 times that of the daughter's age at that time

If the daughter's age is 1x yr then the mother's age is 4x years. 

Adding both the ages, we get 5x yr.

5x = 55

x = 11

Then, Four years back the age of the daughter was 11yrs and the mother was 44 years old

At present,

Daughter is of age 11 + 4 = 15 yrs.

Mother is of age 44 + 4 = 48 yrs.

questions.question: Who founded the Forward Block?
questions.questionHtml: Who founded the Forward Block?
questions.solution:
About Forward Bloc:

  • All India Forward Bloc (AIFB) is a Left Wing Nationalist political party founded by Subhas Chandra Bose in West Bengal in 1939.
  • Forward Bloc of the Indian National Congress (INC) was formed on May 3, 1939, by Subhas Chandra Bose.
  • On the formation of this party Netaji said that who all were joining the Forward Bloc, they had to never turn their back to the Britisher's camp and must fill the oath form by cutting their Finger and signing it with their blood in the form.
  • All India Conference of Forward Bloc held in Nagpur 1940. 
  • The conference passed a resolution titled "All Power to the Indian People", urging militant action for the struggle against the East India Company.
  • About Subhas Chandra Bose:
    • He was born on 23rd January 1897 in Cuttack, Odisha.
    • Subhas Chandra Bose was an active leader of the Indian National Congress.
    • After splitting from Congress, he made an Azad Hind Fauj in Singapore in 1942 to fight against the East India Company.
    • In the year 1923, Subhas Chandra Bose was elected the President of All India Youth Congress and also the Secretary of Bengal State Congress.
    • He was also worked as the Editor of the Newspaper 'Forward', founded by Chittaranjan Das (Deshbandhu).

questions.question: Which place is known as the birthplace of 'Dhamma' and 'Sangha'?
questions.questionHtml: Which place is known as the birthplace of 'Dhamma' and 'Sangha'?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Sarnath.

Key Points

  • Sarnath
    • ​Gautam Buddha gave his first sermon at Sarnath, which is called Dharmachakra Parivartan in Buddhist texts.
    • It is considered to be the birthplace of 'Dhamma' and 'Sangha'.
  • Three Jewels of Buddhism
    • Buddha - The enlightened one
    • Dhamma - Teachings of Gautam Buddha
    • Sangha -  The monastic orders for those who practice Dhamma.

Important Points

  • About Gautam Buddha 
    • Childhood name:- Siddharth
    • He is called the "Light of Asia".
    • He was born between 563 BC in Lumbini, near Kapilavastu, Nepal.
    • His father was Shuddhodana who was the head of Shakya Gan.
    • His mother Mayadevi died seven days after his birth.
    • Prajapati Gautami, Siddharth's stepmother, brought him up.
    • Siddhartha was married at the age of 16 to Dandapani Shakya's daughter Yashodhara.
      • ​His son's name was Rahul.
    • When Siddharth went out for a tour to Kapilavastu, he saw four sights
      • An old person.
      • A sick person.
      • A dead body.
      • A monk in meditation.
    • Saddened by worldly problems, Siddharth left home at the age of 29 which is called Mahabhinishkamana in Buddhism.
    •  After renunciation, Buddha received Sankhya philosophy from Alarkalaam in Vaishali.
      • ​Alarkalam was the first Guru of Buddha.
      • After Alarkalam, Siddhartha got his education from Rudrakaramput of Rajgir.
      • In Uruvela, Siddharth found 5 ascetics named Kaundinya, Vappa, Bhadia, Mahanama, and Assagi.
      • Siddhartha attained enlightenment under the Peepal tree on the banks of the Niranjana River on the full moon night of Vaishakh at the age of 35, after a hard penance of 6 years without consuming food.
      • After attaining enlightenment, Siddhartha came to be known as Buddha.
      • The place where he attained enlightenment is known as Bodh Gaya.
      • Buddha died at the age of 80 in Kushinagar after having a meal offered by Chund which has been called Mahaparinirvana in Buddhism.

questions.question: The population in Jaipur city was 1,00,000 three years ago. If it increased by 4%, 5% in first two year and decreased in third year is 4%. Find the present population of Jaipur city?
questions.questionHtml: The population in Jaipur city was 1,00,000 three years ago. If it increased by 4%, 5% in first two year and decreased in third year is 4%. Find the present population of Jaipur city?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

The successive percentage changes can be calculated directly using multiplying factors.

⇒ Present population = 1,00,000 × (104/100) × (105/100) × (96/100)

⇒ Present population = 1,00,000 × 1.04 × 1.05 × 0.96

⇒ Present population = 109200 × 0.96 = 104832

∴ The correct answer is 104832.

Alternate Method

Given:

Population 3 years ago (P) = 1,00,000

Rate of increase for 1st year (R1) = 4%

Rate of increase for 2nd year (R2) = 5%

Rate of decrease for 3rd year (R3) = 4%

Formula Used:

Final Value = Initial Value × (1 ± R1/100) × (1 ± R2/100) × (1 ± R3/100)

Calculations:

⇒ Present Population = 1,00,000 × (1 + 4/100) × (1 + 5/100) × (1 − 4/100)

⇒ Present Population = 1,00,000 × (104/100) × (105/100) × (96/100)

⇒ Present Population = 1,00,000 × (26/25) × (21/20) × (24/25)

⇒ Present Population = 1,00,000 × (13104 / 12500)

⇒ Present Population = 8 × 13104

⇒ Present Population = 104832

∴ The correct answer is 104832.

Additional Information

Successive Percentage Change

When a value undergoes multiple sequential percentage changes, the final value is determined by multiplying the initial base by the product of all individual multiplying factors: Base × (1 ± a/100) × (1 ± b/100).

Effective Percentage Formula

For two successive percentage changes of x% and y%, the net equivalent percentage change is given by the formula: [x + y + (x × y)/100]%.

Depreciating Value

If the population or the cost of an asset decreases at a constant uniform rate of R% per annum, the future value after n years becomes Base × (1 − R/100)n.

questions.question: If the number 52a2b divisible by 90, then find the minimum value of a 2 + b 2 .
questions.questionHtml: If the number 52a2b divisible by 90, then find the minimum value of a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup>.
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Divisible by 90 means the number is divisible by both 10 and 9.

Unit digit b must be 0 for divisibility by 10.

Sum of digits 5 + 2 + a + 2 + 0 = 9 + a, so for divisibility by 9, a can be 0 or 9.

For minimum a2 + b2, we take a = 0 and b = 0.

Min(a2 + b2) = 02 + 02 = 0.

∴ The correct answer is 0.

Alternate Method

Given:

Number = 52a2b

The number is divisible by 90.

Concept Used:

A number is divisible by 90 if it is divisible by both 10 and 9 (since 10 and 9 are co-prime factors of 90).

Divisibility by 10: The unit digit must be 0.

Divisibility by 9: The sum of the digits must be a multiple of 9.

Calculations:

⇒ For 52a2b to be divisible by 10, the unit digit b = 0.

⇒ The number becomes 52a20.

⇒ For 52a20 to be divisible by 9, the sum of its digits must be a multiple of 9.

⇒ Sum of digits = 5 + 2 + a + 2 + 0 = 9 + a

⇒ For (9 + a) to be a multiple of 9, the possible values for the single digit a are 0 or 9.

⇒ We need the minimum value of a2 + b2.

⇒ Case 1: If a = 0, b = 0, then a2 + b2 = 02 + 02 = 0.

⇒ Case 2: If a = 9, b = 0, then a2 + b2 = 92 + 02 = 81.

⇒ Comparing the cases, the minimum possible value is 0.

∴ The correct answer is 0.

Additional Information

Divisibility Rule of 9

A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 9. This helps in quickly determining the missing digits in a given number.

Divisibility Rule of 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of digits at odd places and the sum of digits at even places is either 0 or a multiple of 11.

Co-prime Factors Trick

To check divisibility by a composite number (like 90 or 72), split it into co-prime factors (like 9 × 10 or 8 × 9). The number must be divisible by both co-prime factors.

questions.question: A train overtake a man going along the railway track at a speed of 7.5 km/hr in 15.4 sec. If the length of the train is \(77 \over 250\) km. Find the speed ( km/h ) of the train.
questions.questionHtml: A train overtake a man going along the railway track at a speed of 7.5 km/hr in 15.4 sec. If the length of the train is \(77 \over 250\) km. Find the speed (km/h) of the train.
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Length of train in meters = (77 / 250) × 1000 = 308 m.

Relative speed = Distance ÷ Time = 308 m ÷ 15.4 s = 20 m/s.

Relative speed in km/h = 20 × (18 / 5) = 72 km/h.

Since both are moving in the same direction, Speed of Train = Relative speed + Speed of man.

Speed of Train = 72 + 7.5 = 79.5 km/h.

∴ The correct answer is 79.5 km/h.

Alternate Method

Given:

Speed of man = 7.5 km/h

Length of train = 77 / 250 km

Time taken to overtake = 15.4 seconds

Formula Used:

Relative Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Calculations:

⇒ Let the speed of the train be V km/h.

⇒ Relative Speed = (V − 7.5) km/h

⇒ Time converted into hours = 15.4 / 3600 hours

⇒ (V − 7.5) = (77 / 250) ÷ (15.4 / 3600)

⇒ (V − 7.5) = (77 / 250) × (3600 / 15.4)

⇒ (V − 7.5) = (77 / 250) × (36000 / 154)

⇒ (V − 7.5) = (77 / 154) × (36000 / 250)

⇒ (V − 7.5) = (1 / 2) × 144

⇒ V − 7.5 = 72

⇒ V = 72 + 7.5

⇒ V = 79.5

∴ The correct answer is 79.5 km/h.

Additional Information

Relative Speed

When two bodies move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds (S1 − S2). If they move in opposite directions, it is the sum of their speeds (S1 + S2).

Train passing a Point Object

When a train passes a man, pole, or a stationary tree, the total distance covered by the train is exactly equal to its own length.

Speed Conversion

To convert a speed from km/h to m/s, multiply it by 5 / 18. To convert from m/s to km/h, multiply the value by 18 / 5.

questions.question: A rectangular sheet of paper 40 cm × 22 cm is rolled to form a hollow cylinder of height 40 cm. The radius of the cylinder (in cm) is
questions.questionHtml: A rectangular sheet of paper 40 cm × 22 cm is rolled to form a hollow cylinder of height 40 cm. The radius of the cylinder (in cm) is
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

The height of the cylinder matches the 40 cm side of the sheet, so the remaining 22 cm side forms the base circumference.

Base Circumference = 22 cm

⇒ 2 × π × r = 22

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × r = 22

⇒ r = 7 ÷ 2 = 3.5 cm

∴ The correct answer is 3.5 cm.

Alternate Method

Given:

Dimensions of the rectangular sheet = 40 cm × 22 cm

Height of the formed hollow cylinder (h) = 40 cm

Formula Used:

Circumference of a circle = 2 × π × r

Calculations:

⇒ When the sheet is rolled to form a cylinder of height 40 cm, the entire length of the 22 cm edge forms the circular boundary at the base.

⇒ Therefore, the circumference of the cylinder's base = 22 cm

⇒ 2 × π × r = 22

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × r = 22

⇒ 44/7 × r = 22

⇒ r = (22 × 7) ÷ 44

⇒ r = 154 ÷ 44

⇒ r = 7 ÷ 2

⇒ r = 3.5 cm

∴ The correct answer is 3.5 cm.

Additional Information

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The curved surface area of a cylinder is given by 2 × π × r × h. This formula matches exactly with the area of the original rectangular sheet used to make it (length × breadth).

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The total surface area of a solid cylinder includes the curved surface area along with the area of the top and bottom circular bases: 2 × π × r × (r + h).

Volume of a Cylinder

The total internal capacity or volume is calculated by multiplying the base area by the height: V = π × r2 × h.

questions.question: The dimension of a rectangular metallic sheet is 42 cm × 28 cm. From each of its corners a square of side 6 cm is cut off. An open box is made from the remaining sheet. Find the volume of the box
questions.questionHtml: The dimension of a rectangular metallic sheet is 42 cm × 28 cm. From each of its corners a square of side 6 cm is cut off. An open box is made from the remaining sheet. Find the volume of the box
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Volume of the box = (Length − 2 × cut side) × (Breadth − 2 × cut side) × cut side

Volume = (42 − 12) × (28 − 12) × 6

Volume = 30 × 16 × 6

Volume = 2880 cm3

∴ The correct answer is 2880 cm3.

Alternate Method

Given:

Length of the metallic sheet = 42 cm

Breadth of the metallic sheet = 28 cm

Side of the square cut from each corner = 6 cm

Formula Used:

Volume of a cuboid = Length × Breadth × Height

Calculations:

When the four corner squares are cut off and the remaining flaps are folded up, they form the sides of the open box.

⇒ Length of the newly formed box = 42 − (2 × 6) = 42 − 12 = 30 cm

⇒ Breadth of the newly formed box = 28 − (2 × 6) = 28 − 12 = 16 cm

⇒ Height of the newly formed box (which is the side of the cut square) = 6 cm

Now, finding the volume of the box:

⇒ Volume = 30 × 16 × 6

⇒ Volume = 480 × 6

⇒ Volume = 2880 cm3

∴ The correct answer is 2880 cm3.

Additional Information

Volume of a Cuboid

The total space occupied by a rectangular 3D object is measured by multiplying its three dimensions: Volume = l × b × h.

Total Surface Area of an Open Box

Since an open box has no top lid, its surface area calculation involves only the bottom base area and the lateral walls: TSA = lb + 2h(l + b).

questions.question: In a parallelogram ABCD, AB = 10 cm and AD = 6 cm. The bisector of ∠A meets DC in E. AE and BC produced meet at F. Find the length of CF.
questions.questionHtml: In a parallelogram ABCD, AB = 10 cm and AD = 6 cm. The bisector of ∠A meets DC in E. AE and BC produced meet at F. Find the length of CF.
questions.solution:
In parallelogram ABCD, AE is the bisector of \(\angle A\)  i.e., ∠EAB = ∠EAD  and CD || AB ⇒ DE || AB & EC || AB

So, ∠EAB = ∠AED [alternate angles] ⇒ ∠AED = ∠EAD

In ΔADE , ∠AED = ∠EAD ⇒ ΔADE is an isosceles triangle.

AD = DE = 6 cm, EC = CD - DE = 10 cm - 6 cm = 4 cm, EC = 4 cm

Now, In ΔABF & ΔECF,  EC || AB ⇒ ∠FAB = ∠FEC and ∠FBA =  ∠FCE [ by corresponding angles] and  ∠F = ∠F [Common angle]

∴ ΔABF ~ ΔECF

The ratio of the corresponding sides will also be equal.

\(\frac{AB}{EC}=\frac{AF}{EF}=\frac{FB}{FC}\) ⇒ \(\frac{10}{4}=\frac{6+FC}{FC}\) ⇒ CF = 4 cm

questions.question: A heap of sand is in the shape of a right circular cone. It has a slant height of 10 feet and a base diameter of 16 feet. Find the volume of sand making up the heap Take π = 3.14
questions.questionHtml: A heap of sand is in the shape of a right circular cone. It has a slant height of 10 feet and a base diameter of 16 feet. Find the volume of sand making up the heap Take π = 3.14
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

In a right circular cone, the slant height (l), radius (r), and height (h) form a right-angled triangle.

Given d = 16 ft ⇒ r = 8 ft. Slant height l = 10 ft.

Using Pythagorean triplets (6, 8, 10), the height h = 6 ft.

Volume of a cone = (1÷3) × π × r2 × h

V = (1÷3) × 3.14 × 82 × 6 = 2 × 3.14 × 64 = 401.92 ft3

∴ The correct answer is 401.92 ft3.

Alternate Method

Given:

Slant height of the cone (l) = 10 ft

Base diameter (d) = 16 ft

Formula Used:

Volume of a cone = (1÷3) × π × r2 × h

Slant height (l) = √(r2 + h2)

Calculations:

⇒ Radius (r) = d ÷ 2 = 16 ÷ 2 = 8 ft

⇒ Slant height (l) = 10 ft

Applying Pythagoras theorem to find the height (h):

⇒ l2 = r2 + h2

⇒ 102 = 82 + h2

⇒ 100 = 64 + h2

⇒ h2 = 36 ⇒ h = 6 ft

Now, finding the volume of the sand heap:

⇒ Volume = (1÷3) × 3.14 × (8)2 × 6

⇒ Volume = 3.14 × 64 × 2

⇒ Volume = 3.14 × 128 = 401.92 ft3

∴ The correct answer is 401.92 ft3.

Additional Information

Curved Surface Area of a Cone

The lateral or curved surface area is given by CSA = π × r × l, where r is the radius and l is the slant height.

Total Surface Area of a Cone

The total surface area includes the base area and is calculated as TSA = π × r × (r + l).

Pythagorean Triplets in Geometry

In cones and right prisms, dimensions often form standard Pythagorean triplets like (3, 4, 5) or (6, 8, 10), which helps in fast mental calculations.

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 1600 was lent partly at 5% and partly at 8% simple interest. The total interest received after 4 years is Rs. 384. The ratio of money lent at 5% to that at 8% is -
questions.questionHtml: A sum of Rs. 1600 was lent partly at 5% and partly at 8% simple interest. The total interest received after 4 years is Rs. 384. The ratio of money lent at 5% to that at 8% is -
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Total interest for 1 year = 384 ÷ 4 = &rupee;96

Overall effective interest rate = (96 ÷ 1600) × 100 = 6%

Applying the Alligation cross-method on the rates:

Ratio of sum at 5% to sum at 8% = (8 − 6) ∶ (6 − 5) = 2 ∶ 1

∴ The correct answer is 2 ∶ 1.

Alternate Method

Given:

Total Principal = &rupee;1600

Total Simple Interest after 4 years = &rupee;384

Rates of interest = 5% and 8%

Formula Used:

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Calculation:

⇒ Let the sum lent at 5% be x.

⇒ Then, sum lent at 8% = (1600 − x)

⇒ (x × 5 × 4) ÷ 100 + ((1600 − x) × 8 × 4) ÷ 100 = 384

⇒ 20x ÷ 100 + (51200 − 32x) ÷ 100 = 384

⇒ 20x + 51200 − 32x = 38400

⇒ 12x = 51200 − 38400

⇒ 12x = 12800

⇒ x = 12800 ÷ 12 = 3200 ÷ 3

⇒ Sum lent at 8% = 1600 − (3200 ÷ 3) = 1600 ÷ 3

⇒ Ratio = (3200 ÷ 3) ∶ (1600 ÷ 3) = 3200 ∶ 1600 = 2 ∶ 1

∴ The correct answer is 2 ∶ 1.

Additional Information

Simple Interest Formula

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100, where P is the principal, R is the rate of interest, and T is the time period in years.

Alligation Method

Used to find the ratio in which two components of different rates or values are mixed to obtain a mixture of a desired average rate. Ratio = (Dearer quantity − Average rate) ∶ (Average rate − Cheaper quantity).

SI vs CI Difference (2 years)

The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest for 2 years at a rate of R% is given by the formula Difference = P(R ÷ 100)2.

questions.question: The average of 12 numbers is 25.5. The average of the first six numbers is 22.4 and that of the last three numbers is 28.2. The 7 th number is 5 less than the 8 th number but 10 less than the 9 th number. What is the average of the 8 th and 9 th numbers?
questions.questionHtml: The average of 12 numbers is 25.5. The average of the first six numbers is 22.4 and that of the last three numbers is 28.2. The 7<sup>th</sup> number is 5 less than the  8<sup>th </sup> number but 10 less than the 9<sup>th</sup> number. What is the average of the 8<sup>th </sup>and 9<sup>th</sup><sup> </sup>numbers?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Net deviation of first 6 and last 3 numbers = 6 × (22.4 − 25.5) + 3 × (28.2 − 25.5) = −18.6 + 8.1 = −10.5.

To balance the deviation, sum of the remaining three numbers (7th, 8th, 9th) = 3 × 25.5 + 10.5 = 87.

Let the 8th number = x, then 7th = x − 5, and 9th = x + 5.

Sum = x − 5 + x + x + 5 = 3x = 87 ⇒ x = 29.

The 8th number is 29 and the 9th number is 29 + 5 = 34.

∴ The correct answer is 31.5.

Alternate Method

Given:

Average of 12 numbers = 25.5

Average of first 6 numbers = 22.4

Average of last 3 numbers = 28.2

Calculations:

⇒ Sum of all 12 numbers = 12 × 25.5 = 306

⇒ Sum of first 6 numbers = 6 × 22.4 = 134.4

⇒ Sum of last 3 numbers = 3 × 28.2 = 84.6

⇒ Sum of 7th, 8th, and 9th numbers = 306 − (134.4 + 84.6) = 306 − 219 = 87

⇒ Let the 7th number be a.

⇒ According to the question, 8th number = a + 5

⇒ 9th number = a + 10

⇒ a + (a + 5) + (a + 10) = 87

⇒ 3a + 15 = 87

⇒ 3a = 72 ⇒ a = 24

⇒ 8th number = 24 + 5 = 29

⇒ 9th number = 24 + 10 = 34

⇒ Average of 8th and 9th numbers = (29 + 34) ÷ 2 = 63 ÷ 2 = 31.5

∴ The correct answer is 31.5.

Additional Information

Deviation Method in Averages

It is a quick way to find missing numbers by calculating how much the given sub-groups deviate from the total average. The net sum of deviations is always balanced by the missing terms.

Weighted Average

Formula = (n1x1 + n2x2 + ... ) ÷ (n1 + n2 + ... ), which is highly useful when combining multiple groups of numbers with different averages.

Arithmetic Progression (A.P.)

If elements are symmetrically spaced with equal differences (like a, a+5, a+10), their average is exactly the middle term.

questions.question: It was intended that Rs. 2,820 be divided among A, B and C in the ratio of 3 : 4 : 5, but by mistake the distributions was made in the proportion of \({1\over 3}:{1\over4}:{1\over5}\) . How much does A gain by the error?
questions.questionHtml: It was intended that Rs. 2,820 be divided among A, B and C in the ratio of 3 : 4 : 5, but by mistake the distributions was made in the proportion of \({1\over 3}:{1\over4}:{1\over5}\). How much does A gain by the error?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

A's intended share = 3 / (3 + 4 + 5) × 2820 = 3/12 × 2820 = Rs. 705

Mistaken ratio = 1/3 : 1/4 : 1/5 ⇒ 20 : 15 : 12 (multiplying by LCM 60)

A's actual share = 20 / (20 + 15 + 12) × 2820 = 20/47 × 2820 = Rs. 1200

A's gain = Actual share − Intended share = 1200 − 705 = Rs. 495

∴ The correct answer is Rs. 495.

Alternate Method

Given:

Total amount to be divided = Rs. 2820

Intended ratio among A, B, and C = 3 : 4 : 5

Mistaken ratio among A, B, and C = 1/3 : 1/4 : 1/5

Formula Used:

Share of individual part = [Individual ratio / Sum of ratios] × Total Amount

Calculation:

⇒ Sum of parts in intended ratio = 3 + 4 + 5 = 12

⇒ Intended share of A = (3 / 12) × 2820 = (1 / 4) × 2820 = Rs. 705

⇒ Mistaken fractional ratio = 1/3 : 1/4 : 1/5

⇒ To convert fractions into integers, multiply by the LCM of denominators 3, 4, and 5, which is 60.

⇒ Actual substituted ratio = (1/3 × 60) : (1/4 × 60) : (1/5 × 60) = 20 : 15 : 12

⇒ Sum of parts in actual mistaken ratio = 20 + 15 + 12 = 47

⇒ Actual share received by A = (20 / 47) × 2820 = 20 × 60 = Rs. 1200

⇒ Gain of A caused by the error = Actual received share − Intended share

⇒ Gain = 1200 − 705 = 495

∴ The correct answer is Rs. 495.

Additional Information

Fractional Ratios to Integer Ratios

When a ratio is given in fractional form, simplify it into whole numbers by multiplying each term by the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of all the denominators.

Proportional Distribution

If a total amount T is divided into three parts in the ratio a : b : c, the corresponding values are (a / S) × T, (b / S) × T, and (c / S) × T where S = a + b + c.

Net Change in Share

Gain or Loss is determined by calculating the difference between the actual distributed value and the originally intended value. A positive difference indicates a gain.

questions.question: If \(2x + { {1} \over 3x}= 5, x ≠ 0\) , then what is the value of \(27x^3+{{1} \over 8x^3}\) ?
questions.questionHtml: If \(2x + { {1} \over 3x}= 5, x ≠ 0\) , then what is the value of \(27x^3+{{1} \over 8x^3}\)?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Multiply 2x + 1/(3x) = 5 by 3/2 to get the terms for cubing.

⇒ 3x + 1/(2x) = 15/2

Here, a = 3x, b = 1/(2x), so their product ab = 3/2.

Apply the shortcut formula: a3 + b3 = (a + b)3 − 3ab(a + b)

⇒ Value = (15/2)3 − 3 × (3/2) × (15/2) = 3375/8 − 135/4 = 3105/8

∴ The correct answer is 3105/8.

Alternate Method

Given:

2x + 1/(3x) = 5

Formula Used:

(a + b)3 = a3 + b3 + 3ab(a + b)

Calculation:

⇒ Multiply the given equation by 3/2 to adjust the coefficients.

⇒ (3/2) × [2x + 1/(3x)] = (3/2) × 5

⇒ 3x + 1/(2x) = 15/2

⇒ Cubing both sides of the equation:

⇒ (3x + 1/(2x))3 = (15/2)3

⇒ (3x)3 + (1/(2x))3 + 3 × (3x) × (1/(2x)) × (3x + 1/(2x)) = 3375/8

⇒ 27x3 + 1/(8x3) + (9/2) × (15/2) = 3375/8

⇒ 27x3 + 1/(8x3) + 135/4 = 3375/8

⇒ 27x3 + 1/(8x3) = 3375/8 − 270/8

⇒ 27x3 + 1/(8x3) = 3105/8

∴ The correct answer is 3105/8.

Additional Information

Sum of Cubes Formula

The algebraic expansion a3 + b3 = (a + b)(a2 − ab + b2) is widely used for factorization. It can also be expressed directly for value calculation as a3 + b3 = (a + b)3 − 3ab(a + b).

Difference of Cubes Formula

Similarly, the difference of cubes is given by a3 − b3 = (a − b)(a2 + ab + b2) or equivalently a3 − b3 = (a − b)3 + 3ab(a − b).

Reciprocal Term Expansions

For an equation of the form x + 1/x = k, we can quickly determine x3 + 1/x3 = k3 − 3k. When the terms have different coefficients like ax + 1/(bx) = k, the identity adjusts to k3 − 3(a/b)k.

questions.question: In a test, 40% of the students passed in Science; 50% passed in English; and 10% passed in both the subjects. Find the percentage of students who have failed.
questions.questionHtml: In a test, 40% of the students passed in Science; 50% passed in English; and 10% passed in both the subjects. Find the percentage of students who have failed.
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Total passed % = Passed in Science + Passed in English − Passed in both

Total passed % = 40% + 50% − 10% = 80%

Students who failed = Total students (100%) − Total passed %

Failed % = 100% − 80% = 20%

∴ The correct answer is 20%.

Alternate Method

Given:

Passed in Science, n(S) = 40%

Passed in English, n(E) = 50%

Passed in both, n(S ∩ E) = 10%

Formula Used:

Passed in at least one subject = n(S ∪ E) = n(S) + n(E) − n(S ∩ E)

Failed % = 100% − n(S ∪ E)

Calculations:

⇒ Students passed in at least one subject = 40% + 50% − 10%

⇒ Students passed = 80%

⇒ Percentage of students who failed = 100% − 80% = 20%

∴ The correct answer is 20%.

Additional Information

Set Theory Basics

The formula for the union of two sets is n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) − n(A ∩ B).

De Morgan's Laws

The complement of the union of two sets is the intersection of their complements: (A ∪ B)' = A' ∩ B'. In this context, failing in both subjects is the complement of passing in at least one.

Venn Diagrams

A visual representation of sets where the total universal set is usually represented by a rectangle (100%) and individual sets are represented by overlapping circles inside it.

Given:

\(\frac{(867+289)^2-(867-289)^2}{(867 \times 289)}\) = ?

Calculation:

⇒ \(\frac{(a + b)^2 - (a - b)^2}{a \times b}\)

⇒ \(\frac{4 \times a \times b}{a \times b}\)

⇒ 4

questions.question: The LCM of two numbers is 140 and their HCF is 35. Find the difference of the two numbers if the larger number is 4 times the smaller number.
questions.questionHtml: The LCM of two numbers is 140 and their HCF is 35. Find the difference of the two numbers if the larger number is 4 times the smaller number.
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

If a number is a multiple of another, their HCF is always the smaller number itself.

Given the larger number is 4 times the smaller, their HCF directly equals the smaller number.

Thus, Smaller Number = HCF = 35.

Larger Number = 4 × 35 = 140.

Difference between them = 140 − 35 = 105.

∴ The correct answer is 105.

Alternate Method

Given:

LCM = 140

HCF = 35

Larger number = 4 × Smaller number

Formula Used:

Product of two numbers = LCM × HCF

Calculations:

⇒ Let the smaller number be x.

⇒ The larger number = 4x.

⇒ x × 4x = 140 × 35

⇒ 4x2 = 4900

⇒ x2 = 1225

⇒ x = 35

⇒ Smaller number = 35

⇒ Larger number = 4 × 35 = 140

⇒ Difference = 140 − 35 = 105

∴ The correct answer is 105.

Additional Information

HCF and LCM of Multiples

If one number 'a' is a multiple of another number 'b', their Highest Common Factor (HCF) is simply 'b' and their Least Common Multiple (LCM) is 'a'.

Product Rule of LCM and HCF

For any two positive integers, the product of the numbers is strictly equal to the product of their HCF and LCM. Formula: N1 × N2 = HCF × LCM.

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are said to be co-prime if their HCF is exactly 1. In such scenarios, their LCM is always the direct product of the two numbers.

questions.question: In the given figure, T point is 13 cm away from centre O and radius of circle is 5 cm. PT and QT are two . tangents intersecting in T. Find the length of AB
questions.questionHtml:
In the given figure, T point is 13 cm away from centre O and radius of circle is 5 cm. PT and QT are two .

tangents intersecting in T. Find the length of AB
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

In this figure, tangent AB intersects tangents PT and QT, making ΔAET similar to ΔOPT.

Given OP = 5 cm, OT = 13 cm → PT = √(132 − 52) = 12 cm.

Distance TE = OT − Radius = 13 − 5 = 8 cm.

Using similarity ratio: AE = (OP × TE) ÷ PT

⇒ AE = (5 × 8) ÷ 12 = 10/3 cm

⇒ Total length AB = 2 × AE = 20/3 cm

∴ The correct answer is 20/3 cm.

Alternate Method

Given:

Radius of the circle, OP = OE = 5 cm

Distance from center to external point T, OT = 13 cm

Formula Used:

Pythagoras Theorem: H2 = P2 + B2

Similarity Ratio for ΔAET ∼ ΔOPT: AE/OP = TE/PT

Calculations:

⇒ In right-angled ΔOPT, using the Pythagoras theorem:

⇒ PT = √(OT2 − OP2) = √(132 − 52)

⇒ PT = √(169 − 25) = √144 = 12 cm

⇒ Point E is on the circle intersecting OT, meaning AB is tangent at E. Hence, OE ⊥ AB.

⇒ TE = OT − OE = 13 − 5 = 8 cm

⇒ In ΔOPT and ΔAET:

⇒ ∠OPT = ∠AET = 90° (Tangent is perpendicular to the radius)

⇒ ∠PTO is a common angle in both triangles.

⇒ ∴ ΔAET ∼ ΔOPT (By Angle-Angle similarity criterion)

⇒ Taking the ratio of corresponding perpendicular and base sides:

⇒ AE / OP = TE / PT

⇒ AE / 5 = 8 / 12

⇒ AE = 40 / 12 = 10/3 cm

⇒ Since line OT bisects the tangent segment AB, total length AB = 2 × AE.

⇒ AB = 2 × (10/3) = 20/3 cm

∴ The correct answer is 20/3 cm.

Additional Information

Properties of Tangents from an External Point

Tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are equal in length (PT = QT) and subtend equal angles at the center of the circle.

Tangent and Radius Relationship

The radius drawn to the point of contact is always directly perpendicular to the tangent. Example: OP ⊥ PT.

Common Angle Similarity

In right-angled triangles sharing a common vertex angle, the triangles are similar by the AA criterion. Hence, their corresponding sides are proportional.

questions.question: On purchasing 3 articles a shopkeeper gives 1 article free. Find the discount percent.
questions.questionHtml: On purchasing 3 articles a shopkeeper gives 1 article free. Find the discount percent.
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Discount % = (Free Items ÷ Total Items) × 100

Free Items = 1

Total Items = 3 (Purchased) + 1 (Free) = 4

Discount % = (1 ÷ 4) × 100 = 25%

∴ The correct answer is 25%.

Alternate Method

Given:

Articles purchased = 3

Articles given free = 1

Formula Used:

Discount % = (Discount ÷ Marked Price) × 100

Calculations:

⇒ Let the Marked Price (MP) of 1 article be 1 unit.

⇒ Total articles taken by the customer = 3 + 1 = 4 articles.

⇒ Total Marked Price (MP) of 4 articles = 4 × 1 = 4 units.

⇒ Selling Price (SP) is charged only for 3 articles = 3 × 1 = 3 units.

⇒ Discount = MP − SP = 4 − 3 = 1 unit.

⇒ Discount % = (1 ÷ 4) × 100

⇒ Discount % = 25%

∴ The correct answer is 25%.

Additional Information

Buy X Get Y Free

In this promotional offer, the customer pays for X items and takes home (X + Y) items. The discount percentage is given directly by (Y ÷ (X + Y)) × 100.

Successive Discounts

When two successive discounts of a% and b% are given, the effective discount = (a + b − a × b ÷ 100)%.

Marked Price (MP) vs Cost Price (CP)

MP = CP + Markup. The discount is always calculated on the Marked Price, while Profit or Loss is calculated strictly on the Cost Price.

questions.question: What is the value of, sin 150 ° × cos 0 ° × tan 67 ° × tan 23 ° × tan 45°
questions.questionHtml: What is the value of, sin 150°  × cos 0° × tan 67° × tan 23° × tan 45°
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

If the sum of two angles A and B is 90°, then tan A × tan B = 1.

Here, 67° + 23° = 90° ⇒ tan 67° × tan 23° = 1

Also we know the standard values: sin 150° = 1 / 2, cos 0° = 1, and tan 45° = 1.

Result = (1 / 2) × 1 × 1 × 1 = 1 / 2

∴ The correct answer is 1 / 2.

Alternate Method

Given:

Expression = sin 150° × cos 0° × tan 67° × tan 23° × tan 45°

Formula Used:

⇒ sin(180° − θ) = sin θ

⇒ tan(90° − θ) = cot θ

⇒ tan θ × cot θ = 1

Calculation:

⇒ sin 150° = sin(180° − 30°) = sin 30° = 1 / 2

⇒ cos 0° = 1

⇒ tan 67° = tan(90° − 23°) = cot 23°

⇒ tan 67° × tan 23° = cot 23° × tan 23° = 1

⇒ tan 45° = 1

Substituting all the simplified values back into the expression:

⇒ Expression = (1 / 2) × 1 × 1 × 1

⇒ Expression = 1 / 2

∴ The correct answer is 1 / 2.

Additional Information

Complementary Angles in Trigonometry

Two angles are complementary if their sum is 90°. Key transformations: tan(90° − θ) = cot θ | sin(90° − θ) = cos θ | sec(90° − θ) = cosec θ.

Supplementary Angles

Two angles are supplementary if their sum is 180°. In the second quadrant, sine is positive: sin(180° − θ) = sin θ. Cosine and tangent are negative: cos(180° − θ) = −cos θ | tan(180° − θ) = −tan θ.

Important Trigonometric Product Rule

Whenever the sum of two angles A and B is 90° (A + B = 90°), the product of their tangents is always 1: tan A × tan B = 1.

questions.question: Due to pandemic, the population of a city reduces at the rate of 2% per annum. What will be its total population after 2 years if the present population of the city is 45,000?
questions.questionHtml: Due to pandemic, the population of a city reduces at the rate of 2% per annum. What will be its total population after 2 years if the present population of the city is 45,000?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Multiplying factor for 2% reduction = 1 − 2/100 = 49/50

Population after 2 years = Present Population × (49/50) × (49/50)

⇒ 45000 × 2401/2500

⇒ 18 × 2401 = 43218

∴ The correct answer is 43218.

Alternate Method

Given:

Present population of the city (P) = 45000

Rate of reduction (R) = 2% per annum

Time (n) = 2 years

Formula Used:

Population after n years = P × (1 − R/100)n

Calculations:

⇒ Population after 2 years = 45000 × (1 − 2/100)2

⇒ Population after 2 years = 45000 × (1 − 1/50)2

⇒ Population after 2 years = 45000 × (49/50)2

⇒ Population after 2 years = 45000 × 49/50 × 49/50

⇒ Population after 2 years = 45000 × 2401/2500

⇒ Population after 2 years = 18 × 2401 = 43218

∴ The correct answer is 43218.

Additional Information

Population Growth

If the population increases at R% per annum, the population after n years is calculated as P × (1 + R/100)n.

Population Depreciation

If the population decreases at R% per annum, the population after n years is calculated as P × (1 − R/100)n.

Successive Percentage Change

If a value undergoes consecutive percentage changes of A% and B%, the net percentage change is given by (A + B + (A × B) ÷ 100)%.

Additional Information

  • Let's break down the options:

    • "ought" - This modal verb is used to give advice or say what is the right thing to do. While "ought to" could technically be used in this sentence ("Drivers know that they ought to slow down..."), it does not convey as strong a sense of obligation as "must".
    • "must" - This is the correct choice. It's often used to express an obligation or necessity, which fits the context of this sentence. In this case, "must" suggests that drivers are obligated to slow down when they approach the main road.

  • The idiom "Give someone the cold shoulder" means to deliberately ignore someone or treat them in an unfriendly manner. (किसी को अनदेखा करना)
    • Example: After their argument, she started giving him the cold shoulder at work.
  • Ignore someone means to refuse to take notice of or acknowledge someone. (किसी को अनदेखा करना)
    • Example: He decided to ignore her calls after their disagreement.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Ignore someone.

  • Unaffected by the surroundings (परिवेश से अप्रभावित): Not influenced or changed by the environment.
    • Example: Despite the chaos around her, she remained unaffected by the surroundings.
  • Injured badly (बुरी तरह घायल): Suffering severe physical harm.
